purpose: Exact stool collision placement with bound-ordered first-contact search and all-triangle independent clipping audit
inputs: Two named stool frame0/startup, original mesh at prior45degreeorientation, fresh standing initialization; no rejected pose vectors
equations: Triangle intersects expanded hull when A*(v0+u*(v1-v0)+v*(v2-v0)-p-t*d)+b<=.006,u>=0,v>=0,u+v<=1. Swept expanded-hull AABB provides lower t bound. Sort bounds; skip only lower>best+1e-9.
mechanism: An early actual closest-triangle witness bounds all farther candidates. Expanded-hull vertices replace insufficient unexpanded AABB+6mm. No LP count increase.
independent_audit: Clip all furniture triangles against every expanded robot hull at returned placement; verify barycentric first-contact witness independently. No AABB exclusion in final placement audit.
tests: Require full original cold-pose, path, timing,20mm inset,12mm hover,6mm mesh clearance and action audit after placement; failure stops named case. No simulation authorized by numerical outcome alone.
